findings.issue: Common noun (H7848, not a locked proper name) is left as the untranslated lemma shitím.
Comma does not mark the construct poles-of wood, so the wood can be read as a second object rather than the material of the poles.

notes: E hizo, y las chapó, and de oro match the two 3ms verbs, the 3mp object, and gold as the overlay material.
